import backend.server as srv

print('Trace 8.8.8.8:', trace_test['org'], '| Verdict:', trace_test['verdict'], '| Genuine:', trace_test['is_genuine'])

print('3. Testing Email Notifier...')
email_cfg = srv.get_email_config()
print('Email config (masked):', email_cfg)
report_html = srv.email_notifier.generate_html_report(srv.run_scan())
